info.title: Prince of Persia 2
info.author: Cardas26
info.details:
The 1993 DOS game Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow and the Flame, statically recompiled to native code for the Switch; the same game code as the PS Vita port (psp2-pop2).

- All levels and cutscenes, FM music and sound effects.
- Save and resume, docked and handheld, standby.
- 4:3 and widescreen views, four filters.
- Every control remappable.

No game data is included. Copy the files of your own DOS game, version 1.1 only, into sdmc:/switch/pop2-recomp/. The first start checks every file and names any that are missing. An optional HOME-menu forwarder is on the GitHub release page.

changelog: Initial release for the Nintendo Switch.
